name: Zurich Seville Marathon
summary: A fast, exceptionally flat marathon through Triana, La Cartuja, Nervion, Plaza de Espana, and Seville's historic center, starting on Avenida de Maria Luisa and finishing on Paseo de las Delicias.
heroNote: Strong cheering spots include Plaza de Armas early in the race, Isla Magica, Gran Plaza, Plaza de Espana, and Plaza Nueva before the final run to Paseo de las Delicias.
specialNote: The race plans to use staggered wave starts after the 08:30 first gun. Check your runner's assigned start time when the organization publishes wave details.
